title: Q-REPOS-MERGE-SPEC: fold the spec repository into ultrastable/ultrastable, then archive it
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** Q-REPOS-MERGE-WORKERS closed (spec_truth needs the code tree it checks)
**Status:** open
**Done check:** grep:brand/brand.json::"into"

code-task: repo=ultrastable/ultrastable path=brand/brand.json
code-anchor: Q-REPOS-MERGE-SPEC

spec/specs and ultrastable/specs differ in 27 files. Reconcile, move SCOPE, LICENSE, COMMERCIAL-TERMS, FAQ and the licensing record into the main repository (the license must stay byte-identical wherever it is copied: foundation fleet `identical` rule), repoint canonical-text links, archive spec with a pointer README.

Closing probe: `python3 brand/tools/sync_repos.py --check`; `python3 tools/spec_truth.py` in the main repository.
